query:
SELECT 
  id,
  companyName,
  SUBSTRING(coreCapabilities, 1, 100) as cap,
  SUBSTRING(valuePropositions, 1, 100) as vp,
  SUBSTRING(icpIndustries, 1, 100) as industries,
  SUBSTRING(icpPainPoints, 1, 100) as pain,
  SUBSTRING(icpBuyingSignals, 1, 100) as signals,
  SUBSTRING(fitCriteria, 1, 100) as fit,
  SUBSTRING(urgencyTriggers, 1, 100) as urgency
FROM offering_brain
WHERE isActive = 1
LIMIT 1;
